narrative.overview:
The page is a colourman's sample card lying open in a linen-bound sketchbook. The ground is a warm basket-weave: linen (#e7d6c2) tiled from images/linen.webp at 270px. Each study is a speckled rag sheet, paper (#f6efe4) tiled from images/sheet.webp at 260px, taped at the top and turned a degree off square, with the price left blank. The density is a book. One spread, then leaves, with the binding stitches on the left.

Ink writes. Graphite qualifies. Walnut is the only accent, and it stays scarce: the stamp, the pencil, the focus ring, the selection, the floating button. Shantell Sans is the artist's hand. Source Serif 4 is the reading voice. The confirmed rejection is the centered artist template and the sibling dark editorial grid.

Mara Ellison and Ink & Linen Studio are fictional. The pictures are photographic stand-ins sitting on the sheets, credited in the colophon.
keyCharacteristics: Linen basket-weave ground and speckled rag sheets, with the sheet lighter than the cloth
One walnut accent against ink and graphite
Shantell Sans for the artist's voice, Source Serif 4 for reading
Pinned, taped, slightly tilted studies and a blank price line
Walnut pencil strokes, hand-cut WhatsApp stamps, and binding stitches on the left
One soft ink shadow; a stroke draws in, then yields to reduced motion

rules.name: The One Walnut Rule
rules.body: Walnut is the only accent hue. Ink and graphite do the reading. A second chromatic color does not belong on the page.

rules.name: The Lightest Sheet Rule
rules.body: The sheet in hand is rag paper, lighter than the linen ground. A study sits on the cloth; it does not darken into a card.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Shantell Sans speaks only in the artist's voice: names, titles, the margin, stamps, filters, the price line, counts. Source Serif 4 speaks only when there is something to read: the lede, prose, the medium line, the colophon. A paragraph does not go into the hand, and the studio name does not go into the serif.

rules.name: The Open Book Rule
rules.body: One book, one gutter, stitches on the left. From 900px the first viewport is a two-page spread: the pinned drawing on the left, the title page on the right. Later leaves stack. The page does not become a centered single column of type, and it does not become a dark editorial grid.

rules.name: The Pin Shadow Rule
rules.body: A sheet at rest uses the pin shadow and nothing else. The shadow is soft and warm. It is not a hard offset, and it does not appear in a second layer under the same sheet.

rules.name: The Square Sheet Rule
rules.body: Rag sheets, the dialog, and the filter chips stay square. The only curves are the hand-cut stamp and the circular floating button.

rules.name: The Slight Tilt Rule
rules.body: A pinned sheet sits about a degree off square, each study on its own angle inside -1.5deg to 1.4deg. Hover, when motion is allowed, settles the study flat. The tilt is small enough that the type stays easy to read.

rules.name: The Blank Price Rule
rules.body: The price line names the blank and then says "Quote on request". It never carries a figure.

rules.name: The Pencil Rule
rules.body: A stroke is walnut, 2.2 wide, round-capped, with pathLength 1. Under a title, along the process thread, and under the pressed filter word, it is one unbroken stroke (stroke-dasharray: 1). Under a resting filter word it is gapped (stroke-dasharray: 0.62 0.16) at 75% opacity.

dos: Do tile the ground with linen (#e7d6c2) and images/linen.webp at 270px, and tile every sheet with paper (#f6efe4) and images/sheet.webp at 260px.
Do keep Shantell Sans on the artist's voice and Source Serif 4 on reading, at the sizes in the frontmatter.
Do pin a study on a square rag sheet with tape at the top, the pin shadow, and a tilt between -1.5deg and 1.4deg.
Do end each study on the blank price line: "Price" at the left, "Quote on request" in deep walnut, on a 1px line of ink at 28% opacity.
Do use the hand-cut stamp for a WhatsApp action and the 3.5rem walnut circle for the floating control.
Do draw focus as a 2px deep-walnut outline, 3px outside the control, and cancel the pencil draw and the hover lift when the visitor prefers reduced motion.
donts: Don't add a second accent hue, a dark editorial ground, or a centered single-column hero.
Don't set a reading paragraph in Shantell Sans, or the studio name and piece titles in Source Serif 4.
Don't round the rag sheets, the dialog, or the filter chips.
Don't replace the pin shadow with a hard offset shadow.
Don't print a price on the blank line.
